conventions.name: packages-have-src-barrel
conventions.description: Workspace packages are consumed as source through src/index.ts, except config-only (tsconfig) and glob-exported (ui) packages.

conventions.name: api-router-modules
conventions.description: Each oRPC router module exports a procedure map named after its (plural) filename and builds procedures from the shared authed/authedWithOrganization builders in ../base, with zod-validated inputs.

conventions.name: services-and-workflows-never-import-api-layer
conventions.description: Services and workflows, at any nesting depth, must not depend on the API layer; dependencies flow routers -> services -> db, never backwards.

conventions.name: ai-and-api-never-import-database
conventions.description: AI tools and API adapters reach persistence only through services.

conventions.name: packages-never-import-server
conventions.description: Workspace packages below @starter/server never import it; dependencies flow apps -> server -> packages.

conventions.name: contract-packages-never-import-persistence
conventions.description: Contract, renderer, file-format and observability packages own no persistence or Redis access; that stays in @starter/server.

conventions.name: db-imports-workspace-contracts-as-types-only
conventions.description: The database package value-imports no workspace package; jsonb columns reference contract types only.

conventions.name: public-renderer-uses-lean-server-entrypoints
conventions.description: The public websites app imports only narrow server subpaths, never the root, dashboard API, auth, chat or MCP graphs.

conventions.name: packages-never-import-app-sources
conventions.description: Package sources and tests never reach into app directories by relative path; apps depend on packages, not the reverse.

conventions.name: ai-tools-export-tool
conventions.description: Each AI tool domain module exports a {domain}Tools map of createTool() definitions from Mastra with Zod-validated schemas.

conventions.name: ai-tools-registry
conventions.description: The tools index aggregates every tool into the dashboardChatTools registry consumed by agents.

conventions.name: ai-agent-module
conventions.description: The single dashboard agent module exports dashboardChatAgent built on Agent from Mastra.

conventions.name: email-templates
conventions.description: Each email template declares a {Name}Email component, exports it as default for react-email previews, and renders with components from the consolidated react-email package.

conventions.name: renderer-packages-shared-structure
conventions.description: The document-rendering packages (email, pdf) share one structure: an i18n locales module exposing getI18n/translations with an en.json catalog, plus shared Footer and Logo components.

conventions.name: shared-utils-export-functions-directly
conventions.description: Each @starter/utils domain module exports its functions directly instead of wrapping them in a file-named namespace object.

conventions.name: db-schema-tables-use-pg-core
conventions.description: Each Drizzle schema module defines its tables with builders from drizzle-orm/pg-core.

conventions.name: db-schema-helpers-export-fields
conventions.description: Each schema helper exports a reusable column group named {helper}Fields. tsvector.ts is excluded: it defines a custom column type, not a column group.

conventions.name: hook-files-export-matching-hook
conventions.description: Files named use-{name}.ts(x) export a hook named use{Name} after the file.

conventions.name: package-barrels-are-pure
conventions.description: These package barrels are pure re-export files; runtime logic must live in the modules they re-export. db and pdf indexes are intentionally impure and are not pinned.

conventions.name: tests-use-test-naming
conventions.description: Test files use the *.test.ts(x) suffix; *.spec files are not allowed.

conventions.name: pdf-ui-components-named-after-file
conventions.description: Each @starter/pdf ui component exports a component matching its kebab-case filename in PascalCase; name collisions with external libraries are resolved by prefixing the file too (pdf-image.tsx -> PdfImage).

conventions.name: ui-chart-components-named-after-directory
conventions.description: Each chart directory's index exports the base chart named after the directory; GenUI-specific wrappers live in genui-charts.tsx.

conventions.name: ui-components-named-after-file
conventions.description: Each @starter/ui component file exports a component matching its kebab-case filename in PascalCase (shadcn-style extra exports are allowed alongside it).

conventions.name: webapp-components-named-after-file
conventions.description: Each webapp component file exports a component matching its kebab-case filename in PascalCase.

conventions.name: webapp-middleware-modules
conventions.description: Each middleware module exports {name}Middleware, composed in src/proxy.ts.

conventions.name: webapp-api-routes-use-error-handler
conventions.description: Route handlers wrap their HTTP method exports with withErrorHandler so errors are logged and mapped to responses consistently.

conventions.name: tests-import-vitest
conventions.description: All test files run on vitest.

conventions.name: tests-have-no-dev-deps-guard
conventions.description: Every package test suite carries the no-dev-deps guard test that keeps runtime imports out of devDependencies.
